newsitem.title: USA: Perma-Fix completes deep well testing.
newsitem.headline: Perma-Fix completes deep well testing.

text.p: Perma-Fix Environmental Services Inc said Thursday mechanical integrity testing of its second non-hazardous injection well, located in Tulsa, Okla., has been completed.

The Oklahoma Department of Environmental Quality granted a permit for this well in October 1996, enabling the facility to utilize the well upon successful completion of the testing, the company said. Perma-Fix plans to place the well into service in January, increasing the capacity and disposal efficiency at the facility. This well will be used for the disposal of industrial wastewaters, once they have been rendered non-hazardous.

"The new well will dramatically increase our water disposal capabilities at our Tulsa facility and reduce our operating costs," Perma-Fix said. "Because of the lower costs, we will be able to compete for wastewater streams at a greater distance. This is a major step in our efforts to make our Tulsa facility a dominant waste handling facility in the midwest." -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
